SERVICE_HEADLINE: Honest repairs, done right the first time
TAGLINE: Family-run since 2008. We tell you what your car actually needs, show you the old parts, and never sell you work you didn't come in for.
SERVICES_INTRO: Everything from an oil change to a full engine rebuild, on domestic and import vehicles alike.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Dealer-level scan tools and a technician who explains the code in plain English before anything gets touched.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Pads, rotors, struts and alignment. Most brake jobs are done the same day you drop the car off.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Factory-interval servicing that keeps your warranty intact, at roughly half what the dealer charges.
WHY_INTRO: There are six shops within ten minutes of here. Here is why people keep driving past them to get to us.
WHY_1_BODY: We photograph the problem, text you the quote, and wait. Nothing gets done without a yes from you.
WHY_2_BODY: A real person picks up during opening hours. If we miss you, you get a call back inside the hour.
WHY_3_BODY: Two loaners on the lot for jobs that run past a day, so you are never stuck arranging a ride.
REVIEW_1_TEXT: Quoted me $1,900 at the dealer for a wheel bearing and control arm. Rivertown did both for $740 and showed me the worn parts afterwards.
REVIEW_2_TEXT: Been taking three family cars here for nine years. They have talked me out of work more than once, which is why I keep coming back.
REVIEW_3_TEXT: Check engine light on a Friday afternoon. They scanned it in the parking lot, found a loose sensor, and did not charge me a cent.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For quotes and bookings the form is usually faster, and it reaches the front desk directly.
